Sam: quick help — enterprise POC with Acme Corp. 3-week Dedicated POC, they want 30% off hosted for month 1 + a custom SLA. what’s the deal desk path?
Maria (Deal Desk): tag here — need committed $ or reserved GPU qty. >25% requires DD manager signoff. also set CPQ fields (see below).
Ashley (SE): technical note — prod-like data will go to Private; they also want KMS & KV cache encryption. we’ll need eng-security review before POC starts.
Sam: ok — customer is fine with a short reserved commit for POC (3 nodes). can we do a temporary SLA for latency and uptime during POC?
Maria (Deal Desk): Temporary SLA = add SLA_Tier = "gold-poc" (internal only). For pricing, push through CPQ with these fields: Commitment_Length_months, Commitment_Type, Discount_pct, POC_flag, SLA_Tier, Private_Deployment_required. sample payload:```yaml
Commitment_Length: 1
Commitment_Type: reserved
Discount_pct: 30
POC: true
SLA_Tier: gold-poc
Private_Deployment_required: false
```
Maria (Deal Desk): attach pricing worksheet and mark deal as "POC — short commit" in SFDC. Also set Approval_Route = dealdesk_escalation if Discount_pct >= 25 or SLA is custom.
Sam: who gets routed automatically?
deal-bot: Approval ticket created: DD-7891. Routing: Maria -> Sarah (Deal Desk Manager) if discount >=25% -> Sarah will approve or escalate to CRO. ETA: 24h business.
Ashley (SE): FYI the Private path will add ~2 days for security signoff. create security questionnaire ticket and tag eng-security.
Jules (Legal): special terms for POC? we'll need a short SOW + liability cap for POC period. I can draft a one-pager if finance signs off on discount.
Maria (Deal Desk): workflow checklist: 1) AE populates CPQ fields, attach usage projection + POC runbook; 2) deal-bot creates DD ticket; 3) Deal Desk triages within 24h; 4) >25% or custom SLA -> Manager approval; 5) Legal if custom terms; 6) Ops/Eng if Private/KMS required.
ops-bot: Note: if Private_Deployment_required=true, open infra change ticket with eng-infra and set "hard-commit" timeline to 7 days.
Sam: perfect, I'll populate CPQ and attach SOW draft. thanks everyone :pray: 
Maria (Deal Desk): I'll pick this up and route to Sarah right after you update CPQ. keep me posted, Sam.
